content2.content: Flutter supports three main types of tests: Unit, Widget, and Integration.

content4.content: Test a single function, method, or class. Fast and isolated.

content7.content: Test a single widget. Verifies UI layout and interaction.

content10.content: Test the complete app or a large part of it. Runs on a real device or emulator.

content12.content: A healthy test suite has many unit tests, fewer widget tests, and even fewer integration tests.
